en.title: The Second Hand in the Stillness, Recipes at the Edge of the Sky
en.premise: With a broken pocket watch hanging from my neck, I travel across a sea of clouds in search of lost 'sounds' and 'tastes.' One day, within a colossal structure resembling underwater ruins appearing through a rift in the clouds, I encounter the 'Memories of the Tide' that once bound the world together. This is a story of quiet rebirth, told through the people I meet, the warm dishes of distant lands, and a clock that remains frozen in time.

zh.title: 凪の底の秒針、空の果てのレシピ
zh.premise: 颈上挂着一块破碎的怀表，我正穿越云海，寻找失落的『声音』与『味道』。某日，在云隙间出现的一座宛如海底遗迹的巨大构造物中，我触碰到了曾经连接世界的『潮骚之记忆』。这是一段关于旅途中邂逅的人们、各地温暖的料理，以及在停滞的时钟中刻下的，静谧重生之物语。
